svg.title: White Black
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid screen colours. White zigzag and lower sweeping edge traced from the exact museum recto image; rectangle boundary preserved.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://art.nelson-atkins.org/objects/22857/white-black; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.
